h: Shoprite reportedly makes fresh move to revive its Nigerian business
p: Retailer Shoprite is said to be taking new steps to return to the Nigerian market after earlier shutting its stores in the country. Details of the plan have not been fully reported.
more: The chain had closed its Nigerian stores after selling the business.
Shoppers online are asking where the new stores would open.
